name: Acid Attack ~Ganmen Houkai Bishounen~
original_name: アシッドアタック～顔面崩壊美少年～
source:
"--my childhood friend had acid thrown on him by a random assailant. My childhood friend's face was burnt until it was unrecognizable."

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/15365]Freem![/url]]

Mikihisa and Kanae were always together. They were friends since childhood, and have stayed incredibly close ever since.

But, Kanae is vain and holds his own beauty above all else, and verbally abuses Mikihisa and his classmates for being "ugly."

The truth is, Mikihisa hates Kanae.

So he decides to get back at him...
